description:
Custom code, site-wide or for ONE page (native first: refused when an element can do it). Pick the operation with `action` and pass that action's arguments (help:true returns its full documentation and schema).
- get_site_custom_code: Get custom code of the site (CSS/JS).
- update_site_custom_code: Update custom code (CSS/JS) for the entire site.
- append_site_custom_code: Append or prepend code to a custom code field.
- get_page_custom_code: Read the custom code of ONE page (CSS / JS / head / body slots in page.settings.custom_code), its budget usage, the element ids and custom classes the code can target on that pa…
- update_page_custom_code: Save custom code for ONE page — only when the element schema can't do what the user asked (NATIVE FIRST: element → its settings/events/bindings → an app → code).

allow_shrink.description: Allow removing more than half of a field: set it when native elements or the CMS replaced that co… [update_site_custom_code, update_page_custom_code]

code_custom_css.description: Custom CSS for the site [update_site_custom_code, update_page_custom_code]

code_custom_javascript.description: Custom JavaScript for the site [update_site_custom_code, update_page_custom_code]

dry_run.description: Validate and show what would be saved, without saving (default: on in confirm mode) [update_page_custom_code]

help.description: Return the action's full documentation and argument schema instead of running it

include_guide.description: Include the custom code coding guide (only needed on first call) [get_site_custom_code]

mode.description: replace (default): set the given slots; append: add after the current code [update_page_custom_code]

native_gap.description: Only when the code was refused and no native way exists: the need, the elements/apps you checked,… [update_site_custom_code, append_site_custom_code, update_page_custom_code]

name: site_code
